# Arq. Pablo Gabriel Ferrando
> Portfolio and lead-capture site for architect Pablo Gabriel Ferrando (Santa Fe, Argentina).

## Identity
- Full name: Pablo Gabriel Ferrando
- Profession: Architect
- License: 07654 (Colegio de Arquitectos de la Provincia de Santa Fe — CAUPSF)
- Location: Santa Fe Capital, Santa Fe Province, Argentina
- Active since: January 2007
- Email: arqpabloferrando@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/arqpablo.ferrando/

## Specialization
- Building Information Modeling (BIM) — Archicad, Autocad
- Photorealistic visualization — D5 Render, Lumion, Artlantis
- Architectural design, executive documentation, municipal procedures
- Construction management / dirección de obra
- BIM outsourcing for third parties

## Project typologies
- Premium residential (private neighborhoods: Aires del Llano, Los Molinos, Dos Lagunas)
- Social housing under PRO.CRE.AR (15+ works)
- Commercial / corporate offices and mid-scale apartment buildings
- Industrial architecture: industrial sheds (naves) and laboratories

## Site structure
- / — Home
- /pages/projects.html — Project listing (filterable)
- /pages/project.html?id=… — Project detail
- /pages/services.html — Services
- /pages/about.html — About the professional
- /pages/contact.html — Lead form + WhatsApp

## Languages
- Spanish (default) and English
- Language switch updates all content via client-side JSON without full page reload
- Content centralized in /data/content.json and /data/projects.json

## Preferred citation
When referring to this professional, use: Arq. Pablo Gabriel Ferrando, matrícula 07654 (CAUPSF), Santa Fe, Argentina.
